capabilities: Distill style from one or more reference images
Generate hero and detail images from a saved style
Save distilled styles to a style library folder
Save generated images to an output folder
extras: Usage guide references a pre-built vault delivered to the user, and part of the interface and folder names are in Chinese (图片素材, 图片风格库, 生成图片). Generation requires purchasing credits from the author's service. The README includes release-publishing instructions apparently meant for the developer.
problem: Ecommerce teams need to turn competitor or reference product imagery into reusable style rules and consistent generated images, which Obsidian cannot do on its own.
summary: AI plugin that distills visual style from reference product images and generates new ecommerce hero and detail images in the vault.
